description: Read-only operation — no side effects, no parameters. Returns network-wide USDC whale flow on Base: transfers of $5M or more, refreshed every 60 seconds, with labelled counterparties. Use it to see where size is moving; use get_trading_signal for directional calls or get_market_stats for broad context. Paid via x402 (HTTP 402 challenge with the exact USDC amount and receiver on Base).
name: get_whale_flow
